what: CMS MC normalisation registry, v3. Keyed by CERN Open Data record ID.
HOW_TO_READ_cross_section_pb: cross_section_pb is sigma_eff: the theory production cross section at the stated order, TIMES the decay branching ratio where the decay is a separate generator step, TIMES any generator-level selection factor. k_factor and gen_filt_eff are PINNED TO 1.0 and must NEVER be set from the provenance block -- every ingredient is already inside cross_section_pb, so setting them again applies the correction twice. This is a deliberate semantic difference from PR #35, where the three fields are independent ATLAS metadata values. See studies/cms_mc_weights_v3/DESIGN.md D4.
target_luminosity_note: Run2016G 7.653 + Run2016H 8.740 fb^-1; the post-golden-JSON data luminosity, so the MC normalisation matches the filtered data.
campaign_required: RunIISummer20UL16NanoAODv9 postVFP; any APV/preVFP record is a hard error (DESIGN.md D5).
sum_of_weights_note: null for every record by design: it is MEASURED at build time as the sum of the Runs-tree genEventSumw over exactly the files that processed successfully and passed the per-file Sigma-w check (DESIGN.md D4).
unknown_record_policy: HARD ERROR. A record absent from this registry aborts the build; nothing is ever stored unweighted.

deliberately_excluded_records.why: Out of scope for this round: the gg->ZZ family 38428-38442 (portal values ~1000x too large, pb-vs-fb), 75567 ZZTo2L2Nu (unresolved 42% discrepancy), 68847 VBF_HToZZTo4L_M125, and the low-mass DY records 35631/35633.

provenance.label: GluGluHToZZTo4L_M125
provenance.matching_filter_already_included: yes (R1, w.r.t. matching/filter -- NOT w.r.t. decay BR)
provenance.br_applied_description: BR(H->llll, l=e/mu/tau), LHC Higgs WG BR table
provenance.reference_order: N3LO QCD+NLO EW ggH production, LHC HiggsWG YR4, mH=125.00 GeV (opened directly: twiki.cern.ch/twiki/bin/view/LHCPhysics/CERNYellowReportPageAt13TeV)
provenance.note: Portal sigma is PRODUCTION-ONLY (confirmed: JHUGen decay card 'ZZ4l_withtaus.input' is a SEPARATE step from the gg_H_quark-mass-effects POWHEG production gridpack). k-factor(1.527) corrects production only; sigma_eff additionally applies BR(H->llll)=2.768e-4 (LHC HiggsWG YR BR page) to get the actual per-event-final-state cross section. Production-level k-factor of 1.527 vs the other Higgs check (VBF, k=0.96) is notably larger -- not fully explained in this session (possibly the 'quark-mass-effects' POWHEG implementation's own order differs from the heavy-top-limit N3LO/NNLO+NNLL YR4 number); flagged, not resolved.
provenance.decision: CHANGED from 44.08 pb (NNLO+NNLL, mH=125.09) to 48.58 pb (N3LO QCD+NLO EW, mH=125.00 -- matches this sample's gridpack name 'M125' exactly; 125.09 row on the same table gives 48.52 pb, a 0.1% difference, confirming the mass-point choice barely matters here). k-factor now 1.683 (was 1.527) -- larger, not smaller; the residual gap vs this specific POWHEG 'quark-mass-effects' implementation is still NOT explained, flagged as before.
provenance.values_are: UNVERIFIED by the v3 round -- carried forward from the v2 normalisation research with its provenance, not re-derived

provenance.label: WZTo3LNu_amcatnloFXFX
provenance.br_applied_description: none needed (decay in ME, MadGraph process name)
provenance.decision: CHANGED: RazorAnalyzer's 4.42965 pb is listed IDENTICALLY for BOTH 'WZTo3LNu_...-powheg-pythia8' AND 'WZTo3LNu_...-amcatnloFXFX-pythia8' in the same file (evidence/razor_xsections.dat lines 155-156) -- i.e. a single externally-adopted recommended number applied regardless of generator, NOT amcatnloFXFX's own computed value. Does NOT satisfy 'same generator/configuration'. A candidate same-generator-family number WAS found (4.924 pb NLO x 1.08 NLO-EW k-factor = 5.318 pb, attributed in search results to the CMS WZ Run3 paper, arXiv:2412.02477) but that is a 13.6 TeV number, not 13 TeV -- a real energy mismatch, and the primary paper itself was not opened directly (only found via search synthesis). Falls back to k=1.0, FLAGGED: sigma_eff = this sample's own generator-level portal value (5.218 pb), no external correction applied.
